profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer  at Miami-Dade County
profile.summary: Software Developer in the Miami area with over 10 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft technologies including but not limited to C#, ASP.net, MVC, and SQL Server. Extensive exposure to Object Oriented Programming, Client-Server Applications and the complete software development life cycle. Agile and Waterfall methodologies exposure.Proven ability to quickly learn new technologies and solve new problems in an efficient manner.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
About IPC:
IPC is an independent SUBWAY® franchisee-owned and operated purchasing cooperative handling all the supply-chain needs for all 25,000 SUBWAY Restaurants in North-America including, Purchasing, Distribution, Quality, Finance and Services. IPC also manages many of the SUBWAY brand Technologies, including the SUBWAY Gift Card Program, SubwayPOS, SubwayTV and SubwayRadio.
